text:
maria-partnerships: OpenCove sent a redistribution addendum for their 7B model. They want marketplace listings + ability to bundle with our appliance SKUs. Asking for an embargoed joint announcement. Thoughts?
alan-legal: Key concerns: any NC/non-commercial language blocks marketplace. Need explicit commercial redistribution grant and Exhibit for geo/export restrictions.
rita-ops: We need manifest + SHA256, provenance attestation, and signing key fingerprint. Also S3 path + KMS policy if encrypted.
maria-partnerships: Uploaded the draft: https://redwood.internal/drive/opencove/addendum-draft.pdf
alan-legal: Draft edit suggestion: add clause "Distributor may sublicense customers for runtime inference; Provider to list any export or sanction restrictions in Exhibit A."
tony-hw: For bundles we require a firmware compatibility statement and separate SKU for "bundle" vs "software-only". Also hardware validation takes ~5 business days.
nora-product: Marketplace needs: SKU, short desc (<=180 chars), tags (quantized/7B), model-family, latency bucket, pricing tiers, owner contact, README link. Prefer separate SKUs for SW vs HW bundle.
krita-ops: (typo correction) Rita will run artifact scanning and pre-quant test. Need provider to PGP-sign weights.
rita-ops: Ops checklist: verify SHA256, check signed_manifest.json, run malware scan, test quantized sample prompts, enforce allowed_regions field.
maria-partnerships: Provider asked for May 20 announcement. Can we do that?
nora-product: If we get signed addendum + artifacts by May 2, product+ops can make May 20. Tight but OK. Need legal sign-off by May 6.
alan-legal: I'll prepare addendum v2 and Exhibit A template; need provider to accept share-alike exceptions if they're CC-BY-SA.
maria-partnerships: Action items: 1) Maria request signed manifest & fingerprint today (due Apr 22) 2) Alan to draft addendum v2 (due Apr 29) 3) Rita to prepare ops ticket & entitlement flow (due May 3) 4) Nora to draft SKU/readme templates (due Apr 30) 5) Tony to book HW validation (start May 2)
announce-bot: Note: announcement draft will be created after signatures and checks.
maria-partnerships: Thanks all 10. I'll update thread when we have the signed manifest.
